title: Science Museum 1925-1927 Blaschka dispersal recipient web audit
purpose: Record what can and cannot be recovered from publicly indexed web sources before moving the recipient problem into exact Science Museum Group archive series.

dispersal_statement.statement: UCL states that the Science Museum deaccessioned its glass-model collection between 1925 and 1927 and transferred models to University College London and six other institutions.

publicly_identified_recipients_in_this_a.institution: University College London, Grant Museum of Zoology
publicly_identified_recipients_in_this_a.evidence: UCL's own collection page states that its later Blaschka models entered from the Science Museum during the 1925-1927 deaccession.

publicly_identified_recipients_in_this_a.institution: Cardiff / Amgueddfa Cymru - National Museum Wales
publicly_identified_recipients_in_this_a.evidence: Museum Wales and NatSCA state that 62 Blaschka models came to Cardiff from the Science Museum in 1927.

bounded_web_search_result.result: No third recipient was securely identified in the targeted publicly indexed web pass.
query_families: Blaschka Science Museum 1927 transfer institution excluding UCL/Cardiff
Blaschka Science Museum six other institutions
bounded_web_search_result.guard: This is a bounded negative web result, not evidence that the five remaining recipients are unknowable or absent from archive records.

interpretive_value: The Science Museum deaccession cannot be treated as a single institutional-transfer event. Secure evidence already shows institutional recipients and later private-market survivals. Exact old register numbers are therefore more useful than maker-name searches for reconstructing the split.

archive_route.status: identifier recovered from project provenance backend; contents not publicly indexed
